```sql
-- name: top_products
-- owner: merchandising
-- params: tenant_id, from, to, limit
WITH o AS (
    SELECT id
      FROM orders
     WHERE tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s
       AND created_at >= %(from)s
       AND created_at <  %(to)s
       AND status IN ('paid', 'processing', 'shipped', 'delivered')
),
lines AS (
    SELECT pv.product_id,
           ol.order_id,
           pv.id AS variant_id,
           ol.quantity,
           ol.line_total_cents
      FROM order_lines ol
      JOIN o ON o.id = ol.order_id
      JOIN product_variants pv ON pv.id = ol.variant_id::uuid
),
agg AS (
    SELECT product_id,
           count(DISTINCT order_id)     AS order_count,
           sum(quantity)                AS quantity,
           sum(line_total_cents)        AS revenue_cents,
           count(DISTINCT variant_id)   AS variant_count
      FROM lines
     GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT p.id,
       p.sku,
       p.name,
       p.brand,
       p.currency,
       a.order_count,
       a.quantity,
       a.revenue_cents,
       a.variant_count
  FROM agg a
  JOIN products p ON p.id = a.product_id
 ORDER BY a.quantity DESC, a.revenue_cents DESC
 LIMIT %(limit)s
```

De producttabel wordt nu pas na de aggregatie gejoind, dus alleen op de groepen in plaats van op alle orderregels, en de sorts werken op smalle rijen. De join op `products` blijft inner en levert geen rijen weg, omdat `product_variants.product_id` een verplichte foreign key naar `products` is. Ik kan de winst niet garanderen zonder EXPLAIN ANALYZE op de echte data; gelijke ORDER BY-waarden hebben in het origineel ook een niet-gedefinieerde volgorde.
